name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with feet on floor. Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control, then press it back up to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline. Lower bar to upper chest, then press back up with control.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to decline position. Lower bar to lower chest area and press back up, targeting lower chest.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press dumbbells up and slightly inward until nearly locked out.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to incline. Press dumbbells from shoulder height upward and inward with full control.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On decline bench, press dumbbells from shoulder level upward, emphasizing lower chest contraction.

name: Dumbbell Flye
instructions: Lie on bench with slight bend in elbows. Lower dumbbells out to sides in an arc, then bring them back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Flye
instructions: On incline bench, perform fly motion with dumbbells, focusing on the upper chest contraction.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between two cable stacks, grab handles, and pull cables across your body with a controlled arc motion.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit upright, grip handles at shoulder height, and press straight ahead until nearly extended.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean forward on dip bars to emphasize chest. Lower body until elbows reach 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Lower your body until chest nearly touches the floor, keeping elbows at 45-degree angle. Push back to start.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Perform push-ups with hands elevated on a bench to reduce resistance and focus on form.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: With feet elevated, perform push-ups to increase resistance and target upper chest.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grip bar with hands shoulder-width apart. Pull body upward until chin clears the bar, then lower with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wide, and pull down to upper chest. Control the weight as it returns.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend. Row barbell to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades, and control descent.

name: Underhand Barbell Row
instructions: Row barbell with underhand grip to place more emphasis on the lats and biceps.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, row dumbbell to ribs with one arm, keeping core engaged. Alternate arms.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support yourself on a bench, row dumbbell to your ribs with full range of motion.

name: Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright at cable machine, grab handle, and row toward your body with controlled motion.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit on machine, chest up, and pull cable handles to your torso, squeezing shoulder blades together.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine or corner. Row the weighted end to your chest with explosive power.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Using rope attachment, pull cable toward your face, separating the rope ends and pulling elbows back.

name: Reverse Machine Flye
instructions: Sit upright on machine, grab handles, and pull them backward in a fly motion to work rear delts and back.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Press barbell from shoulders straight overhead to lockout. Keep core tight and avoid excessive arch.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulder height overhead, maintaining a neutral wrist position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright on machine and press handles overhead to full extension.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand upright, raise dumbbells out to sides to shoulder height with slight elbow bend, then lower with control.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Using low pulley, raise single cable handle out to side to shoulder height and control descent.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells in front of body from hips to shoulder height, then lower with control.

name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Hold weight plate at chest level and raise overhead, targeting front delts.

name: Reverse Flye
instructions: Bend at hips, raise dumbbells out to sides with slight elbow bend to target rear delts.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold barbell at waist, pull it upward along your body, keeping elbows high until bar reaches chest level.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Pull dumbbells upward along the sides of your body, focusing on elbow drive.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulder height with a twist, rotating palms from facing you to facing away at the top.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Hold barbell at waist, curl it toward chest, squeeze at top, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells toward shoulders, maintaining control throughout the full range of motion.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other) and curl toward shoulders.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at preacher bench, rest upper arms on pad, and curl bar toward forehead.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Perform curl motion on preacher bench with dumbbells for one-arm isolation.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, let dumbbells hang, and curl upward with full stretch at bottom.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit upright, brace elbow against inner thigh, and curl dumbbell toward shoulder.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Using low pulley, curl cable handle toward chest, maintaining constant tension throughout.

name: Machine Curl
instructions: Sit on machine, grip handles, and curl toward shoulders with controlled motion.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, hold bar overhead, lower to forehead by bending elbows, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, hold dumbbells overhead, and lower them behind your head by bending elbows.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Use EZ bar for skull crusher to reduce wrist strain while performing the overhead extension.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind head by bending elbows, then press back up.

name: Cable Overhead Extension
instructions: Using high pulley with rope attachment, press cable downward from behind your head.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Using rope or bar attachment at high pulley, push cable downward in front of body, fully extending arms.

name: Reverse Grip Pushdown
instructions: Use underhand grip on cable pushdown to target medial head of triceps.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Press barbell with hands closer than shoulder-width to emphasize triceps involvement.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Keep body upright on dips, lower body by bending elbows, then press back up to emphasize triceps.

name: Assisted Tricep Dip
instructions: Use assistance machine to perform dips with reduced body weight for tricep development.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge at hips, keep upper arm stationary, extend dumbbell backward by straightening your arm.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Using low pulley, extend arm backward against resistance, keeping upper arm still.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Place bar on upper back, descend until thighs reach parallel, then drive through heels to stand.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Hold bar across front delts, squat down until thighs are parallel, keeping chest upright.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit on machine, push platform away by extending legs, control descent, and avoid locking knees.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit upright, place feet under pads, and extend legs forward against resistance until straight.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position back against pad on hack squat machine, squat down until thighs reach parallel.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower hips until back knee nearly touches floor, then drive back to start.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, lunge forward, lower hips, and return to start position.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot on bench behind you, step forward and squat until front thigh is parallel.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat down with elbows inside knees, keeping chest upright.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Lean back while bending knees, using a support for balance, to heavily load the quadriceps.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Using Smith machine bar, squat down until thighs reach parallel, maintaining upright posture.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at waist, hinge at hips with slight knee bend, lower bar along legs until feeling stretch.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, hinge at hips and lower weights down the front of legs.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on machine, curl your legs upward, squeeze hamstrings at top, then lower with control.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit upright on machine, place feet under pads, and curl legs downward against resistance.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on floor, slowly lower body forward, resisting the fall with hamstrings, then drive back up.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Place bar on shoulders, hinge at hips with slight bend, lower torso until feeling stretch, then stand.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with minimal knee bend, lower barbell while hinging at hips until feeling hamstring stretch.

name: Cable Curl Hamstring
instructions: Using low pulley and ankle attachment, curl one leg upward against cable resistance.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with back against bench, place bar across hips, drive hips upward, squeeze glutes at top.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Perform hip thrust holding dumbbells across hips for added resistance.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on hip thrust machine, press footplate away to drive hips upward and engage glutes.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, drive hips upward, squeeze glutes at the top position.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Perform glute bridge with one leg extended to increase intensity and isolate each glute.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Using low pulley with ankle attachment, kick one leg backward against cable resistance.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand wide, toes out, deadlift bar keeping chest upright to emphasize glute activation.

name: Machine Glute Abduction
instructions: Sit on machine, push legs outward against resistance to target outer glutes and abductors.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on machine, place feet on platform, and raise up on toes by extending ankles.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold barbell on shoulders, raise up on toes, squeeze calves at top, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, raise up on toes, and lower with controlled motion.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on machine with feet on platform, press up onto toes against resistance, focusing on lower calf.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Use Smith machine for calf raises, standing with feet on platform.

name: Cable Calf Raise
instructions: Using low pulley, stand and raise onto toes against cable resistance.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, curl your torso upward toward knees, squeeze abs at top.

name: Machine Crunch
instructions: Sit on machine, grip handles, and perform crunching motion against resistance.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Using high pulley with rope attachment, crunch forward by flexing your abs against resistance.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs up to form 90-degree angle at hips, lower with control.

name: Seated Leg Raise
instructions: Sit on bench or chair, pull knees toward chest, then extend legs back out.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with wheel in hands, roll forward, extend your body, then pull back using your abs.

name: Decline Situp
instructions: Lie on decline bench, curl torso up toward knees against gravity and body weight.

name: Plank
instructions: Support body on forearms and toes, keep body straight, hold position while engaging core.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Support body on one forearm and feet, keep body in straight line, hold without rotating.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell at waist, raise shoulders toward ears, squeeze traps at top, then lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, shrug shoulders upward, squeeze traps, then lower with control.

name: Machine Shrug
instructions: Sit on machine, grip handles, and shrug shoulders upward against resistance.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
instructions: Using Smith machine bar, perform shrugs with controlled range of motion.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Deadlift bar from elevated position (pins set at mid-shin), focusing on upper back and traps.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold barbell with underhand grip, rest forearms on bench, and curl bar by flexing wrists upward.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with underhand grip, rest forearms on bench, and curl upward using wrist flexion.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold barbell with overhand grip, rest forearms on bench, and extend bar upward using wrist extension.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with overhand grip on bench, extend upward by extending wrists.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Using low pulley with handle, perform wrist curls against cable resistance.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides and walk forward, maintaining upright posture.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand over bar, grip it, keep chest up and back straight, drive through heels to lift.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Using trap bar, stand inside handles, grip them, and deadlift with neutral spine and vertical shin.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Standard deadlift with conventional stance, focus on engaging lats and maintaining neutral spine.

name: Sumo Deadlift High
instructions: Wide stance deadlift variation emphasizing glute and quad activation.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold resistance band at chest level, pull apart by moving hands outward, keeping arms straight.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Using inclined bench, row barbell to chest with support, reducing lower back strain.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: With bar in landmine, stand perpendicular, row weight toward hip with explosive motion.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit on machine, grab handles, and pull toward your torso with controlled motion.

name: Band Resisted Dip
instructions: Perform dips with band assistance by looping band over dip bars and under your legs.

name: Resistance Band Chest Fly
instructions: Attach bands to posts at shoulder height, step forward, and perform fly motion against resistance.

name: Cable Machine Fly
instructions: Using adjacent cable stacks, perform fly motion by pulling handles together across body.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Press dumbbells together at chest level, maintaining pressure between them throughout.

name: Machine Pec Deck
instructions: Sit on machine, place arms on pads, and pull handles together in front of chest.
